scope: Duplicate-parameter rejection for failed registry entries with an explicit canonical parameter digest.
implemented: Strategy specs can retain a validated SHA-256 parameter identity.
Registry rejects the same parameter digest when a failed trial is re-registered under a renamed strategy ID or family.
The canonical parameter digest is independent of mapping key order and rejects non-finite/non-JSON input.
Existing failed-trial ledger and FAILED status history remain immutable.

tests.result: 26 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed for registry.py.

limitations: The existing 13 historical failure rows do not contain canonical parameter hashes, so exact duplicate detection cannot yet be backfilled for those trials without their original parameter artifacts.
Registration only enforces duplicate protection when parameter_sha256 is supplied.
